scenes.name: whitespace_safelight-light
scenes.probe: (() => { const box = (e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return [r.x, r.y, r.width, r.height]; }; return [...document.querySelectorAll('.view-overlays svg')].map((s) => ({ fill: s.getAttribute('fill'), box: box(s) })); })()
